nodes.text: And now, in honor of St. Patrick's Day, please enjoy this `free` special short story!
nodes.text_bbcode: And now, in honor of St. Patrick's Day, please enjoy this [b]free[/b] special short story!

nodes.title: O.M.G.! It's St. Patrick's Day!
nodes.subtitle: Can Paula and Beth throw a great party?

nodes.text: It's morning at the O.M.G. Sorority at Centerscore U. Beth whistles as she moves around the kitchen, making some breakfast...
When the sorority's newest member wanders in!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hi there! Want some muffins?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ugh... You are `way` too chipper for 7 am.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... You are [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too chipper for 7 am.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text_bbcode: ...It's [color=#3b78e2][i]10.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's before noon, which means I'm enforcing my zero tolerance policy on whistling, dancing, or making eye-contact.
Paula walks over, grabs a muffin, and sits down. Beth cautiously joins her.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So... How are you liking being a member of the sorority so far?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Gee, Beth, I don't know. One year ago, I was the Queen Bee at my high school, dating the hottest guys and making everyone do whatever I wanted...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Now, thanks to a little legal... Misunderstanding... I'm wallowing at this third-tier state school, stuck at the lowest slot on the totem pole in some crappy sorority!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh...
Paula sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But I guess... Some of the other sisters... Aren't `so` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I guess... Some of the other sisters... Aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Do you have any big plans for the weekend?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Actually, yeah! Every six months, I get a `total` makeover.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, yeah! Every six months, I get a [color=#3b78e2][i]total[/i][/color] makeover.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm talking haircut... Spa treatment... Massage... Mani... Pedi... Breddi...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What's a `Breddi`?
nodes.text_bbcode: What's a [color=#3b78e2][i]Breddi[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you have to ask, then you really shouldn't know. What are your plans?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, I'm having a really romantic weekend with my boyfriend... We're gonna go take a trip down the coast, stop by some beaches, and stay at this really nice resort...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I hate to be the bearer of bad news, ladies... But you'll be doing no such things.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh... Who am I kidding? I `love` being the bearer of bad news!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Who am I kidding? I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] being the bearer of bad news!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Tina?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm talking about sorority business... Namely, the annual bake sale! We need to bake 500 cookies by Monday...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And of course, as the junior sisters, you'll be responsible for... All of them!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Are you going to help at least?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh, no? The other sisters and I are taking a girl's trip to Vegas! Can you say `part-ay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no? The other sisters and I are taking a girl's trip to Vegas! Can you say [color=#3b78e2][i]part-ay![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I can, but I choose not to...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, Tina, this is totally unfair! We're `not` your servants!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Tina, this is totally unfair! We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] your servants!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You can't make us do this!
Tina locks eyes with Paula and paces towards her...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Now you listen here, `new girl,` and listen well. I am the Head Sister of this sorority. Do you know what that means?
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you listen here, [color=#3b78e2][i]new girl,[/i][/color] and listen well. I am the Head Sister of this sorority. Do you know what that means?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It `means` I know everything about you. I know exactly why you were kicked out of your high school, and why no other college would take you.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]means[/i][/color] I know everything about you. I know exactly why you were kicked out of your high school, and why no other college would take you.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It means I took you into this sorority as an act of kindness, because frankly, no one else would have you...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But if you don't do exactly what I say... Then you'll be back out on your butt faster than you can say 'Mani Breddi.' Got it?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...Got it.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well... What about me? I don't have any dark secret to be blackmailed with. Do `I` have to bake cookies?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... What about me? I don't have any dark secret to be blackmailed with. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to bake cookies?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...Shut up, Beth.
Tina stalks off. When she's gone, Paula slams her fist down on the table!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Grrrr!` I hate her!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Grrrr![/i][/color] I hate her!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: She's really been on kind of an angry tear lately...
Beth sighs deeply and starts taking out some baking supplies...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well, 500 cookies aren't going to bake themselves...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. No way. This girl does `not` bake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nuh-uh. No way. This girl does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] bake.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So what are you saying we should do?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I say we fight back! Rebel! Viva la revolucion or whatever!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... How? She's the Head Sister!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah? And how did she get to be the Head Sister in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Don't you know that story? It's legendary!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: When she was just a freshman and a new member, she went behind her Head Sister's back and threw a huge holiday party!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It was such a success, everyone rallied behind her! Ever since then, she's been untouchable!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, that's it then, isn't it? We should do the same thing! We'll throw our own awesome holiday party!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Believe me, Beth... I know a thing or two about throwing a party...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's not that easy!
Beth walks over to a corkboard and points to a piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: This is the Party Itinerary for the year... And Tina's already claimed all the major holidays!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Halloween... Christmas... Valentine's... Second Valentine's... Tina Day...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sometimes she just makes holidays up!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: There has to be `something` she missed!
nodes.text_bbcode: There has to be [color=#3b78e2][i]something[/i][/color] she missed!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well... Actually... She did miss one thing... It looks like she didn't schedule a party for St. Patrick's Day!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: We spread rumors that Tina is racist against Irish people?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What? No! Why would you even think that?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: We should throw a St. Patrick's Day party!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmm... I suppose that works too...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Think about it! All the other sisters are out of the house this weekend! That means it's the perfect opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Although... I don't know how we'd manage to do it in time... I mean, St. Patrick's Day is tonight!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So that's... What... 5 hours, give or take, for two people to throw together a campus-wide party so good it'll completely destabilize the social order and result in a new regime?
Paula stands up and cracks her knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Piece of cake.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: You're... Pretty scary...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yes, Beth. Yes, I am.
Moments later, Paula and Beth walk across the campus...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: All right, the first thing a party needs is great themed decor.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Normally, I'd rely on either a squad of cheerleaders or cheap third-world laborers...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm just going to pretend that's a joke...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But we don't have time to do this right. So it's time to go for the next best thing...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Social outcasts!
Paula leads Beth into the theater department. There, on the stage, Dinah and Raven are rehearsing for a play...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: If only we'd paid more attention... If only we'd been more caring and observant... We might have prevented this tragedy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't blame yourself, Margaret... There's no way we could have known he had the disease where you slowly turn into a horse.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And I'm just going to stop you two right there!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I was kind of curious to see where it was going...
The two girls turn to stare at Paula.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What do you want, Paula?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm sure you've been waiting your whole life to hear this, Goth-face, but I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh, this is going to be good...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Beth and I are throwing a St. Patrick's day party tomorrow, and we're going to need some assistance with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So you came to... Us?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Don't play innocent, Pigtails. I know you've got a vault back there of props and costumes, and `some` of them have got to be a good match for St. Patrick's Day!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't play innocent, Pigtails. I know you've got a vault back there of props and costumes, and [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] of them have got to be a good match for St. Patrick's Day!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well... We do have all those pots of gold...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And the leprechaun outfits...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And the banner saying 'Happy St. Patrick's Day 2012'... Man, that was a weird play...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: See? I knew it! Now hand that stuff over, and we'll be on our way!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, that's not going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That stuff belongs to the Centerscore U. Theater Department! We can't just give it to you guys! What if its broken or messed up? Those parties get pretty rowdy...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Last time I went to a frat party, I saw a guy eat a frying pan!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, I see how this is. You're not going to give us the props without something in exchange...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: No, we're just not going to give you the props.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on... There must be `something` we can bribe you with...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on... There must be [color=#3b78e2][i]something[/i][/color] we can bribe you with...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh! I know! We'll let you guys come to the party, and you can invite all your friends! And... `And...` You can handle all the music!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I know! We'll let you guys come to the party, and you can invite all your friends! And... [color=#3b78e2][i]And...[/i][/color] You can handle all the music!

nodes.text: Dinah and Raven look at each other...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... We `were` looking for something to do this weekend...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... We [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] looking for something to do this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I `was` kind of getting into DJ-ing...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] kind of getting into DJ-ing...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What do you say, Paula? Do we have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...Fine. Deal. But no songs with the words 'blood,' 'maggot,' or 'corpse-tacular.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Deal!
Paula and Beth walk out of the theater department...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: That went well!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Thanks to your little deal, we're going to have our party packed wall-to-wall with weirdos and vampires!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... We got all the decorations...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, and we could have got them way easier if you'd just let `me` handle it! Those girls were three keenly-observant insults from caving!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and we could have got them way easier if you'd just let [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] handle it! Those girls were three keenly-observant insults from caving!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't know if that's true...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just sit back and look cute from now on, okay? I've got this covered.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Okay...
And so, a little while later, at the MAN frat house...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So... Can I count on you boys to make an appearance?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: A St. Patrick's Day party... Heck yeah! That sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: We'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Is it okay with Tina if we bring dates?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Actually... Tina's not really involved in this party.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's just something Paula and I are doing!
The guys immediately back away, startled...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Whoa... So is this... An `unauthorized` party...?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... So is this... An [color=#e23b3b][i]unauthorized[/i][/color] party...?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well... I didn't know you had to 'authorize' a party, but...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry girls, but there's no way we can get mixed up in this...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Tina gets `real` scary when people go behind her back. Last time someone tried something like this, we all ended up having to clean all the O.M.G. bathrooms!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tina gets [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] scary when people go behind her back. Last time someone tried something like this, we all ended up having to clean all the O.M.G. bathrooms!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Girls are surprisingly messy...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Let me get this straight... You guys won't got to a party... Because you're afraid Tina will be mad at you?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: That's about right, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But it's not like she's a part of your frat! Why would she be able to make you do anything?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Tina is pretty persuasive...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Wow. Just wow. I thought I'd seen everything... But this is a new low.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: A bunch of college guys `utterly terrified` of a 100 pound girl. That's just `pathetic!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A bunch of college guys [color=#3b78e2][i]utterly terrified[/i][/color] of a 100 pound girl. That's just [color=#3b78e2][i]pathetic![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, we... We're not terrified...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? You're scared out of your minds! You're quaking in your boots!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No! We're just... You know... Respectful...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Respectful? Ha! Where's Tina's respect for your desire to party?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just admit... You guys are sad, little babies, scared crapless of her!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: We're not scared of her!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But you still let her tell you what to do!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: No! No one tells us what to do!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Then stand up to her!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah! We'll stand up to her! Who does she think she is?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Stupid Tina!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So if she doesn't want you to go this party...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Then we're going to this party!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Party `party!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Party [color=#e23b3b][i]party![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Great! See you guys at eight o'clock, sharp! Wear green!
Paula and Beth leave...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: ...Does anyone else feel like we just got conned?
And so, Paula spends the rest of the day going from person to person, manipulating...

nodes.speaker: Fabric Store Clerk
nodes.text: A charity to help color-blind orphans? Why, of course I'll donate all my green fabric!
And deceiving...

nodes.speaker: Nursery Clerk
nodes.text: You represent the Irish Heritage Foundation, you say? That's wonderful! I'd love to offer you all my shamrocks and clovers!
And outright bullying!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Cater my party!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cater my party![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Okay, okay! Just stop yelling!
As the sun sets, Paula and Beth head back towards the O.M.G sorority...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Phew! I can't even remember the last time I had to throw together a party just like that! Talk about a rush!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So we're done then?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: We've got decorations, music, catering, and we've put out invites to the whole school... I'd say that counts as done, yeah!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I just feel gross... Like I've compromised every part of my moral code...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, you'll get over it.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't know... We lied to a lot of people...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: 'Lied' is such a strong word, Beth. I prefer to think we 'took artistic license with the truth!'

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It feels like you're lying to me right now!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... I suppose it was all for a good cause...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Exactly! And when we're the most popular girls on campus, and Tina's a pathetic loser stuck shining our shoes, you won't feel bad about a thing!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Why does she have to be shining my shoes?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just relax, would you? Everything's going to work out `just fine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just relax, would you? Everything's going to work out [color=#3b78e2][i]just fine![/i][/color]

nodes.text: But an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: This is a disaster! The party's about to start, and no one's here!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm sure people are just coming fashionably late...
Beth clicks frantically on her laptop...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't think so, Paula! I've been monitoring the party's Faceplace Event Page, and no one has RSVP-ed!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: All those people who promised us they'd come... They must have changed their minds!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmm... I was worried this might happen...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: We came so close...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Like my grandpa always said, close only counts in hand-shoes and horse-grenades. It's time for us to go to Plan B.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: There's a Plan B?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: There's `always` a Plan B. Give me that computer!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] a Plan B. Give me that computer!

nodes.text: Paula takes Beth's laptop and starts typing...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh, just updating the party's description... Instead of being a boring old St. Patrick's Day party... It's now a special event commemorating visiting Irish superstar Hawk Gunner!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Wait, what? Is he even Irish?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sure! Probably! Maybe? I don't know, does it even matter? People are going to be so excited to see him, they'll show up in droves!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... He's not actually going to be here, is he?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh, of course not! How would I possibly arrange that?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So now we're lying to the `entire school?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So now we're lying to the [color=#3b78e2][i]entire school?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paula reaches over and gently touches Beth's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh, Beth... Sweet, stupid Beth...  Of course we are!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Won't they be upset?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Of course not! Once they get here, they'll be having such a good time, they'll forget all about it!
Beth shakes her head and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I said no, Paula. All day long, we've been getting our way by tricking and bribing and bullying people... And I've had enough!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I am `not` lying to the whole school! I'm just not!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] lying to the whole school! I'm just not!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, well, guess what, Goody Two-Shoes? It's not `your` choice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, guess what, Goody Two-Shoes? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] choice!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: No, you're right, it's not. You can do whatever terrible thing you want.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But you know what? I'm out!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You're `out?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]out?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm out. Have fun with your lying and cheating party, Paula.
Beth turns and storms out.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Fine! I will! And I'll do enough lying and cheating for both of us!
And so, fifteen minutes later...
The house is packed full of party-goers!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Rocking party, Paula!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Thanks, Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah, this is actually a lot of fun! And the music is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Glad to hear it, Adam!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I'm having a blast!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sure you are... Guy... Sure you are.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Stupid Beth... Storming out all huffy...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, if she doesn't want to be popular, then that's her choice! I'll get all the benefit for myself!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Anyone want any snacks? Drinks? We've got four-leaf-clover cupcakes... Shamrock shortcake... And some very special green punch...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... When's Hawk getting here?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what I'm pumped about! That guy is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I have to admit, I'm actually kind of excited to meet him too... He was so good in 'Eskimo Kisses...'

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Right... Well... About that... He actually might be a little delayed...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: What? Delayed? Weak!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Right! Well... Why don't you all just hang out and enjoy the party... And... Uh... See what happens!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on... Just get into it... Forget all about stupid Hawk Gunner...
But as the minutes creep by, the guests just get more and more irritated!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Come on! Where is he?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, it's been half an hour already!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: He's an Irish hero!
James narrows his gaze...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: What's the deal, Paula? Where's Hawk?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well... See... The thing is... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hawk `might` not actually be coming...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hawk [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] not actually be coming...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It's... Um... Kind of a funny story, actually... He...
Paula is cut off by an angry roar of complaints and accusations!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You totally tricked us into coming!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I feel used and lied to!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I can't believe I was willing to piss off Tina for `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I was willing to piss off Tina for [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: No! Wait! I...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I'm out of here, Paula!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah! Me too!
Everyone turns to leave... When the door flies open!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk-o! Is everyone to ready to get down with the Hawk... St. Patrick's Day style?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Holy! It's Hawk Gunner!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: That's Hawk `O'Gunner` to you today... Because I'm celebrating my Irish heritage!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's Hawk [color=#e23b3b][i]O'Gunner[/i][/color] to you today... Because I'm celebrating my Irish heritage!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: This so awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I'm so excited I'm shaking!
Hawk saunters into the room with his entourage of bros!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: I'm ready to get this party started...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But first, I just want to give a shout-out to the two special-sauce chicklets that put this whole thing together... Paula and Beth!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh... Right! Thanks! I... Um... Appreciate that!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Now everyone... It's time to `Hawk and Roll!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now everyone... It's time to [color=#e23b3b][i]Hawk and Roll![/i][/color]

nodes.text: People cheer and whoop! Raven blasts some party music, and everyone starts dancing!
Paula steps back, surprised... And finds herself standing next to Beth!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Beth! You're here! Are you... Are you seeing this?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, I am... And it looks like `our` party is one heck of a success!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I am... And it looks like [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] party is one heck of a success!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But... Hawk... How?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I guess we'll just have to write it off as 'luck of the Irish...'

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Also, I know this girl Lisa who works in Hollywood. She's pretty well-connected.
Paula turns to Beth.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Thanks, Beth. I... I hate saying this... But you were right, and I was wrong. I shouldn't have lied.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, well, keep that in mind for next time!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Next time?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well, yeah...
Beth turns to survey the room, where everyone is having a great time! Hawk does his distinctive Hawk Shuffle in the middle of the room!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I think this is the start of a pretty beautiful friendship...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Now come on! Let me get you a shamrock shake!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sounds good!
Wow! Looks like Paula and Beth managed to work out their differences and throw a great party!
Have a happy St. Patrick's Day, and we'll see you next week!
And now, in honor of St. Patrick's Day, please enjoy this `free` special short story!
nodes.text_bbcode: And now, in honor of St. Patrick's Day, please enjoy this [b]free[/b] special short story!

nodes.title: O.M.G.! It's St. Patrick's Day!
nodes.subtitle: Can Paula and Beth throw a great party?

nodes.text: It's morning at the O.M.G. Sorority at Centerscore U. Beth whistles as she moves around the kitchen, making some breakfast...
When the sorority's newest member wanders in!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hi there! Want some muffins?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ugh... You are `way` too chipper for 7 am.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... You are [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too chipper for 7 am.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text_bbcode: ...It's [color=#3b78e2][i]10.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's before noon, which means I'm enforcing my zero tolerance policy on whistling, dancing, or making eye-contact.
Paula walks over, grabs a muffin, and sits down. Beth cautiously joins her.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So... How are you liking being a member of the sorority so far?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Gee, Beth, I don't know. One year ago, I was the Queen Bee at my high school, dating the hottest guys and making everyone do whatever I wanted...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Now, thanks to a little legal... Misunderstanding... I'm wallowing at this third-tier state school, stuck at the lowest slot on the totem pole in some crappy sorority!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh...
Paula sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But I guess... Some of the other sisters... Aren't `so` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I guess... Some of the other sisters... Aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Do you have any big plans for the weekend?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Actually, yeah! Every six months, I get a `total` makeover.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, yeah! Every six months, I get a [color=#3b78e2][i]total[/i][/color] makeover.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm talking haircut... Spa treatment... Massage... Mani... Pedi... Breddi...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What's a `Breddi`?
nodes.text_bbcode: What's a [color=#3b78e2][i]Breddi[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you have to ask, then you really shouldn't know. What are your plans?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, I'm having a really romantic weekend with my boyfriend... We're gonna go take a trip down the coast, stop by some beaches, and stay at this really nice resort...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I hate to be the bearer of bad news, ladies... But you'll be doing no such things.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh... Who am I kidding? I `love` being the bearer of bad news!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Who am I kidding? I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] being the bearer of bad news!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Tina?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm talking about sorority business... Namely, the annual bake sale! We need to bake 500 cookies by Monday...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And of course, as the junior sisters, you'll be responsible for... All of them!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Are you going to help at least?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh, no? The other sisters and I are taking a girl's trip to Vegas! Can you say `part-ay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no? The other sisters and I are taking a girl's trip to Vegas! Can you say [color=#3b78e2][i]part-ay![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I can, but I choose not to...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, Tina, this is totally unfair! We're `not` your servants!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Tina, this is totally unfair! We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] your servants!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You can't make us do this!
Tina locks eyes with Paula and paces towards her...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Now you listen here, `new girl,` and listen well. I am the Head Sister of this sorority. Do you know what that means?
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you listen here, [color=#3b78e2][i]new girl,[/i][/color] and listen well. I am the Head Sister of this sorority. Do you know what that means?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It `means` I know everything about you. I know exactly why you were kicked out of your high school, and why no other college would take you.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]means[/i][/color] I know everything about you. I know exactly why you were kicked out of your high school, and why no other college would take you.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It means I took you into this sorority as an act of kindness, because frankly, no one else would have you...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But if you don't do exactly what I say... Then you'll be back out on your butt faster than you can say 'Mani Breddi.' Got it?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...Got it.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well... What about me? I don't have any dark secret to be blackmailed with. Do `I` have to bake cookies?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... What about me? I don't have any dark secret to be blackmailed with. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to bake cookies?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...Shut up, Beth.
Tina stalks off. When she's gone, Paula slams her fist down on the table!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Grrrr!` I hate her!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Grrrr![/i][/color] I hate her!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: She's really been on kind of an angry tear lately...
Beth sighs deeply and starts taking out some baking supplies...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well, 500 cookies aren't going to bake themselves...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. No way. This girl does `not` bake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nuh-uh. No way. This girl does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] bake.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So what are you saying we should do?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I say we fight back! Rebel! Viva la revolucion or whatever!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... How? She's the Head Sister!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah? And how did she get to be the Head Sister in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Don't you know that story? It's legendary!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: When she was just a freshman and a new member, she went behind her Head Sister's back and threw a huge holiday party!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It was such a success, everyone rallied behind her! Ever since then, she's been untouchable!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, that's it then, isn't it? We should do the same thing! We'll throw our own awesome holiday party!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Believe me, Beth... I know a thing or two about throwing a party...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's not that easy!
Beth walks over to a corkboard and points to a piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: This is the Party Itinerary for the year... And Tina's already claimed all the major holidays!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Halloween... Christmas... Valentine's... Second Valentine's... Tina Day...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sometimes she just makes holidays up!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: There has to be `something` she missed!
nodes.text_bbcode: There has to be [color=#3b78e2][i]something[/i][/color] she missed!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well... Actually... She did miss one thing... It looks like she didn't schedule a party for St. Patrick's Day!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: We spread rumors that Tina is racist against Irish people?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What? No! Why would you even think that?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: We should throw a St. Patrick's Day party!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmm... I suppose that works too...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Think about it! All the other sisters are out of the house this weekend! That means it's the perfect opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Although... I don't know how we'd manage to do it in time... I mean, St. Patrick's Day is tonight!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So that's... What... 5 hours, give or take, for two people to throw together a campus-wide party so good it'll completely destabilize the social order and result in a new regime?
Paula stands up and cracks her knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Piece of cake.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: You're... Pretty scary...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yes, Beth. Yes, I am.
Moments later, Paula and Beth walk across the campus...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: All right, the first thing a party needs is great themed decor.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Normally, I'd rely on either a squad of cheerleaders or cheap third-world laborers...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm just going to pretend that's a joke...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But we don't have time to do this right. So it's time to go for the next best thing...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Social outcasts!
Paula leads Beth into the theater department. There, on the stage, Dinah and Raven are rehearsing for a play...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: If only we'd paid more attention... If only we'd been more caring and observant... We might have prevented this tragedy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't blame yourself, Margaret... There's no way we could have known he had the disease where you slowly turn into a horse.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And I'm just going to stop you two right there!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I was kind of curious to see where it was going...
The two girls turn to stare at Paula.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What do you want, Paula?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm sure you've been waiting your whole life to hear this, Goth-face, but I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh, this is going to be good...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Beth and I are throwing a St. Patrick's day party tomorrow, and we're going to need some assistance with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So you came to... Us?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Don't play innocent, Pigtails. I know you've got a vault back there of props and costumes, and `some` of them have got to be a good match for St. Patrick's Day!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't play innocent, Pigtails. I know you've got a vault back there of props and costumes, and [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] of them have got to be a good match for St. Patrick's Day!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well... We do have all those pots of gold...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And the leprechaun outfits...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And the banner saying 'Happy St. Patrick's Day 2012'... Man, that was a weird play...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: See? I knew it! Now hand that stuff over, and we'll be on our way!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, that's not going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That stuff belongs to the Centerscore U. Theater Department! We can't just give it to you guys! What if its broken or messed up? Those parties get pretty rowdy...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Last time I went to a frat party, I saw a guy eat a frying pan!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, I see how this is. You're not going to give us the props without something in exchange...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: No, we're just not going to give you the props.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on... There must be `something` we can bribe you with...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on... There must be [color=#3b78e2][i]something[/i][/color] we can bribe you with...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh! I know! We'll let you guys come to the party, and you can invite all your friends! And... `And...` You can handle all the music!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I know! We'll let you guys come to the party, and you can invite all your friends! And... [color=#3b78e2][i]And...[/i][/color] You can handle all the music!

nodes.text: Dinah and Raven look at each other...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... We `were` looking for something to do this weekend...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... We [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] looking for something to do this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I `was` kind of getting into DJ-ing...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] kind of getting into DJ-ing...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What do you say, Paula? Do we have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...Fine. Deal. But no songs with the words 'blood,' 'maggot,' or 'corpse-tacular.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Deal!
Paula and Beth walk out of the theater department...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: That went well!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Thanks to your little deal, we're going to have our party packed wall-to-wall with weirdos and vampires!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... We got all the decorations...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, and we could have got them way easier if you'd just let `me` handle it! Those girls were three keenly-observant insults from caving!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and we could have got them way easier if you'd just let [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] handle it! Those girls were three keenly-observant insults from caving!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't know if that's true...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just sit back and look cute from now on, okay? I've got this covered.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Okay...
And so, a little while later, at the MAN frat house...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So... Can I count on you boys to make an appearance?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: A St. Patrick's Day party... Heck yeah! That sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: We'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Is it okay with Tina if we bring dates?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Actually... Tina's not really involved in this party.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It's just something Paula and I are doing!
The guys immediately back away, startled...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Whoa... So is this... An `unauthorized` party...?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... So is this... An [color=#e23b3b][i]unauthorized[/i][/color] party...?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well... I didn't know you had to 'authorize' a party, but...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry girls, but there's no way we can get mixed up in this...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Tina gets `real` scary when people go behind her back. Last time someone tried something like this, we all ended up having to clean all the O.M.G. bathrooms!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tina gets [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] scary when people go behind her back. Last time someone tried something like this, we all ended up having to clean all the O.M.G. bathrooms!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Girls are surprisingly messy...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Let me get this straight... You guys won't got to a party... Because you're afraid Tina will be mad at you?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: That's about right, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But it's not like she's a part of your frat! Why would she be able to make you do anything?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Tina is pretty persuasive...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Wow. Just wow. I thought I'd seen everything... But this is a new low.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: A bunch of college guys `utterly terrified` of a 100 pound girl. That's just `pathetic!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A bunch of college guys [color=#3b78e2][i]utterly terrified[/i][/color] of a 100 pound girl. That's just [color=#3b78e2][i]pathetic![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, we... We're not terrified...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? You're scared out of your minds! You're quaking in your boots!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No! We're just... You know... Respectful...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Respectful? Ha! Where's Tina's respect for your desire to party?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just admit... You guys are sad, little babies, scared crapless of her!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: We're not scared of her!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But you still let her tell you what to do!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: No! No one tells us what to do!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Then stand up to her!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah! We'll stand up to her! Who does she think she is?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Stupid Tina!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So if she doesn't want you to go this party...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Then we're going to this party!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Party `party!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Party [color=#e23b3b][i]party![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Great! See you guys at eight o'clock, sharp! Wear green!
Paula and Beth leave...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: ...Does anyone else feel like we just got conned?
And so, Paula spends the rest of the day going from person to person, manipulating...

nodes.speaker: Fabric Store Clerk
nodes.text: A charity to help color-blind orphans? Why, of course I'll donate all my green fabric!
And deceiving...

nodes.speaker: Nursery Clerk
nodes.text: You represent the Irish Heritage Foundation, you say? That's wonderful! I'd love to offer you all my shamrocks and clovers!
And outright bullying!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Cater my party!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cater my party![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Okay, okay! Just stop yelling!
As the sun sets, Paula and Beth head back towards the O.M.G sorority...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Phew! I can't even remember the last time I had to throw together a party just like that! Talk about a rush!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So we're done then?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: We've got decorations, music, catering, and we've put out invites to the whole school... I'd say that counts as done, yeah!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I just feel gross... Like I've compromised every part of my moral code...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, you'll get over it.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't know... We lied to a lot of people...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: 'Lied' is such a strong word, Beth. I prefer to think we 'took artistic license with the truth!'

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: It feels like you're lying to me right now!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... I suppose it was all for a good cause...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Exactly! And when we're the most popular girls on campus, and Tina's a pathetic loser stuck shining our shoes, you won't feel bad about a thing!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Why does she have to be shining my shoes?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just relax, would you? Everything's going to work out `just fine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just relax, would you? Everything's going to work out [color=#3b78e2][i]just fine![/i][/color]

nodes.text: But an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: This is a disaster! The party's about to start, and no one's here!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm sure people are just coming fashionably late...
Beth clicks frantically on her laptop...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I don't think so, Paula! I've been monitoring the party's Faceplace Event Page, and no one has RSVP-ed!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: All those people who promised us they'd come... They must have changed their minds!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmm... I was worried this might happen...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: We came so close...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Like my grandpa always said, close only counts in hand-shoes and horse-grenades. It's time for us to go to Plan B.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: There's a Plan B?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: There's `always` a Plan B. Give me that computer!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] a Plan B. Give me that computer!

nodes.text: Paula takes Beth's laptop and starts typing...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh, just updating the party's description... Instead of being a boring old St. Patrick's Day party... It's now a special event commemorating visiting Irish superstar Hawk Gunner!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Wait, what? Is he even Irish?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sure! Probably! Maybe? I don't know, does it even matter? People are going to be so excited to see him, they'll show up in droves!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... He's not actually going to be here, is he?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh, of course not! How would I possibly arrange that?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So now we're lying to the `entire school?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So now we're lying to the [color=#3b78e2][i]entire school?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paula reaches over and gently touches Beth's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh, Beth... Sweet, stupid Beth...  Of course we are!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Won't they be upset?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Of course not! Once they get here, they'll be having such a good time, they'll forget all about it!
Beth shakes her head and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I said no, Paula. All day long, we've been getting our way by tricking and bribing and bullying people... And I've had enough!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I am `not` lying to the whole school! I'm just not!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] lying to the whole school! I'm just not!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, well, guess what, Goody Two-Shoes? It's not `your` choice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, guess what, Goody Two-Shoes? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] choice!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: No, you're right, it's not. You can do whatever terrible thing you want.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But you know what? I'm out!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You're `out?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]out?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm out. Have fun with your lying and cheating party, Paula.
Beth turns and storms out.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Fine! I will! And I'll do enough lying and cheating for both of us!
And so, fifteen minutes later...
The house is packed full of party-goers!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Rocking party, Paula!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Thanks, Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah, this is actually a lot of fun! And the music is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Glad to hear it, Adam!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I'm having a blast!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sure you are... Guy... Sure you are.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Stupid Beth... Storming out all huffy...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, if she doesn't want to be popular, then that's her choice! I'll get all the benefit for myself!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Anyone want any snacks? Drinks? We've got four-leaf-clover cupcakes... Shamrock shortcake... And some very special green punch...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... When's Hawk getting here?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what I'm pumped about! That guy is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I have to admit, I'm actually kind of excited to meet him too... He was so good in 'Eskimo Kisses...'

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Right... Well... About that... He actually might be a little delayed...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: What? Delayed? Weak!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Right! Well... Why don't you all just hang out and enjoy the party... And... Uh... See what happens!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on... Just get into it... Forget all about stupid Hawk Gunner...
But as the minutes creep by, the guests just get more and more irritated!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Come on! Where is he?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, it's been half an hour already!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: He's an Irish hero!
James narrows his gaze...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: What's the deal, Paula? Where's Hawk?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well... See... The thing is... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hawk `might` not actually be coming...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hawk [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] not actually be coming...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It's... Um... Kind of a funny story, actually... He...
Paula is cut off by an angry roar of complaints and accusations!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You totally tricked us into coming!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I feel used and lied to!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I can't believe I was willing to piss off Tina for `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I was willing to piss off Tina for [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: No! Wait! I...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I'm out of here, Paula!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah! Me too!
Everyone turns to leave... When the door flies open!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk-o! Is everyone to ready to get down with the Hawk... St. Patrick's Day style?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Holy! It's Hawk Gunner!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: That's Hawk `O'Gunner` to you today... Because I'm celebrating my Irish heritage!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's Hawk [color=#e23b3b][i]O'Gunner[/i][/color] to you today... Because I'm celebrating my Irish heritage!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: This so awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I'm so excited I'm shaking!
Hawk saunters into the room with his entourage of bros!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: I'm ready to get this party started...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But first, I just want to give a shout-out to the two special-sauce chicklets that put this whole thing together... Paula and Beth!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh... Right! Thanks! I... Um... Appreciate that!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Now everyone... It's time to `Hawk and Roll!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now everyone... It's time to [color=#e23b3b][i]Hawk and Roll![/i][/color]

nodes.text: People cheer and whoop! Raven blasts some party music, and everyone starts dancing!
Paula steps back, surprised... And finds herself standing next to Beth!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Beth! You're here! Are you... Are you seeing this?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, I am... And it looks like `our` party is one heck of a success!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I am... And it looks like [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] party is one heck of a success!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But... Hawk... How?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I guess we'll just have to write it off as 'luck of the Irish...'

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Also, I know this girl Lisa who works in Hollywood. She's pretty well-connected.
Paula turns to Beth.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Thanks, Beth. I... I hate saying this... But you were right, and I was wrong. I shouldn't have lied.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, well, keep that in mind for next time!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Next time?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Well, yeah...
Beth turns to survey the room, where everyone is having a great time! Hawk does his distinctive Hawk Shuffle in the middle of the room!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I think this is the start of a pretty beautiful friendship...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Now come on! Let me get you a shamrock shake!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Sounds good!
Wow! Looks like Paula and Beth managed to work out their differences and throw a great party!
Have a happy St. Patrick's Day, and we'll see you next week!
